---
title: "Generalized Clustering"
output: html_document
---

This R Markdown file reproduces the RSMod-based clustering and downstream module analyses used in this study. It performs BH-SNE mapping, OPTICS-based module extraction, visualization of module expression patterns, overlay of selected genes of interest, and export of module-assignment tables.

### Required input files
- `physco_mol-plant-data.csv`: tissue/developmental-stage expression matrix using the v1.6-style gene IDs used in the original RSMod analysis.
- `geneid_interest.csv`: optional list of genes of interest and display names.
- `P.patens_lookup_table_20230906.xlsx`: gene-ID lookup table used to map v1.6-style IDs to the latest v6 gene IDs.

### Main output files
- `All-Modules-3D-Testing.csv`: RSMod/OPTICS module assignments with BH-SNE coordinates.
- `All-Modules-3D-Testing_v6.csv`: the same module assignments with the corresponding v6 gene IDs added from the lookup table.
- `RSMod_expression_module_table.csv`: expression values, v6 IDs, BH-SNE coordinates, and module assignments combined in one table.

The analysis uses BH-SNE with perplexity = 25, three dimensions, theta = 0.5, 1,000 iterations, seed = 100, and lying = 500. OPTICS clustering is performed with cutoff = 55.

```{r, include=FALSE}
## =========================================================
## LIBRARIES
## =========================================================

library(RSMod)
library(fpc)
library(plyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(clusterSim)
library(reshape)
library(reshape2)
library(rgl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## READ IN DATA FILES
```{r}
## =========================================================
## READ DATA
## =========================================================

# Expression data for all genes
data <- read.csv(
  "physco_mol-plant-data.csv",
  header = TRUE
)

# Convert gene IDs from V6 to V6.1 format
# Example: Pp1s1_100V6 -> Pp1s1_100V6.1
data$itag <- paste0(data$itag, ".1")


# List of genes of interest for subsequent module assignment
# These genes are not used to define the clusters
interest <- read.csv(
  "geneid_interest.csv",
  header = TRUE
)

colnames(interest)[1] <- "itag"
## =========================================================
## EXPAND INTEREST GENE IDs
## Split multiple IDs separated by ";" and treat each ID as an independent gene
## =========================================================

interest.expanded <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(interest)), function(i) {

    ids <- unlist(
      strsplit(
        as.character(interest$itag[i]),
        ";",
        fixed = TRUE
      )
    )

    ids <- trimws(ids)
    ids <- ids[ids != ""]

    data.frame(
      itag = ids,
      Name = interest$Name[i],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

rownames(interest.expanded) <- NULL

print(interest.expanded)
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## LOG TRANSFORM AND NORMALIZE
## =========================================================

# Use the complete expression dataset
# No gene subset is applied before clustering

cluster.set <- data_norm(
  trans = data
)

# Check dimensions
dim(cluster.set)
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## BH-SNE MAPPING
## =========================================================

cluster.matrix <- clusterSNE(
  data.set = cluster.set,
  perp = 25,
  dim = 3,
  tha = 0.5,
  pc = FALSE,
  iter = 1000,
  seed = 100,
  lying = 500
)
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## SELECT BEST CUTOFF VALUE
## =========================================================

cutoffTest <- clusteringOPtions(
  cluster = cluster.matrix,
  dim = 3
)

print(cutoffTest)
```


```{r}
## =========================================================
## MODULE EXTRACTION
## =========================================================

# Select the cutoff based on the cutoff evaluation above
modules <- clusteringOptics(
  cluster = cluster.matrix,
  cutoff = 55,
  dim = 3
)

# Retain gene IDs explicitly as a column for downstream analyses
modules$itag <- rownames(modules)

# Check the number of genes assigned to each module
table(modules$colors)
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
## =========================================================
## SHOWTIME MAPPING
## =========================================================

x <- showtimeMapping(
  base = cluster.matrix,
  clusters = modules,
  dim = 3
)

# Optional: create an interactive 3D widget for HTML output
# widget <- rglwidget()
```


```{r}
## =========================================================
## MODULE OVERLAY
## =========================================================

# Example: overlay modules 1-6
ModOverlay(
  base = cluster.matrix,
  clusters = modules,
  n = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6),
  dim = 3
)
## =========================================================
## SAVE ALL MODULE INFORMATION
## =========================================================

write.csv(
  modules,
  "All-Modules-3D-Testing.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## MAP ORIGINAL GENE IDs TO V6 GENE IDs

The original RSMod analysis uses the v1.6-style gene identifiers retained in the
published expression dataset. The following step adds the corresponding v6 gene
IDs without changing the BH-SNE coordinates or OPTICS module assignments.

```{r}
## =========================================================
## GENE-ID CONVERSION: v1.6-style IDs -> v6 IDs
## =========================================================

# Read the P. patens gene-ID lookup table.
# The exact worksheet/column names are detected below so that the conversion
# remains explicit and reproducible.
lookup_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  "P.patens_lookup_table_20230906.xlsx"
)

# Identify the v6 and v1.6 columns.
v6_col <- grep(
  "^Gene_ID_v6$",
  names(lookup_raw),
  value = TRUE
)

v16_col <- grep(
  "gene_id_v1\\.6",
  names(lookup_raw),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(v6_col) != 1 || length(v16_col) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Could not uniquely identify the Gene_ID_v6 and gene_id_v1.6 columns ",
    "in P.patens_lookup_table_20230906.xlsx. Check the worksheet/header row."
  )
}

lookup_v6 <- lookup_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene_ID_v6 = dplyr::all_of(v6_col),
    itag = dplyr::all_of(v16_col)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(itag, sep = ";") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    itag = trimws(itag),
    Gene_ID_v6 = trimws(Gene_ID_v6)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(itag), itag != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(itag, Gene_ID_v6)

# Add v6 IDs to the module table.
# BH-SNE coordinates and module assignments are retained unchanged.
modules_v6 <- modules %>%
  dplyr::left_join(lookup_v6, by = "itag")

# Export the v6-annotated module table.
readr::write_csv(
  modules_v6,
  "All-Modules-3D-Testing_v6.csv"
)

# Report mapping coverage.
cat(
  "Genes with a mapped v6 ID:",
  sum(!is.na(modules_v6$Gene_ID_v6)),
  "of",
  nrow(modules_v6),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## GENES OF INTEREST
## =========================================================

# Use the expanded gene-of-interest table
# Multiple IDs originally stored in one cell are treated as independent entries
interest.modules <- merge(
  interest.expanded,
  modules,
  by = "itag",
  all.x = FALSE,
  all.y = FALSE,
  sort = FALSE
)

# Inspect the resulting table
print(interest.modules)

# Identify genes of interest that are absent from the expression dataset
interest.not.found <- interest.expanded[
  !interest.expanded$itag %in% data$itag,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

cat("\nInterest IDs not found in expression data:\n")
print(interest.not.found)

# Save the output table
write.csv(
  interest.modules,
  "Genes-of-interest-Modules.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
## =========================================================
## MODULE TRANSCRIPT PATTERNS
## + GENES OF INTEREST OVERLAY
##
## Black line   = Module Median
## Grey area    = Module Q1-Q3
## Colored line = Gene of interest
## =========================================================

# Module IDs, excluding the unclassified ("grey") group
module.ids <- sort(
  as.numeric(
    setdiff(
      unique(as.character(modules$colors)),
      "grey"
    )
  )
)

# Check dimensions
print(module.ids)
length(module.ids)


## =========================================================
## Iterate over all modules
## =========================================================

for (k in module.ids) {

  cat("\nProcessing Module", k, "\n")


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 1. Genes assigned to module k
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  module.genes <- modules$itag[
    as.character(modules$colors) == as.character(k)
  ]

  module.genes <- module.genes[
    !is.na(module.genes) & module.genes != ""
  ]


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2. Extract expression data
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.sne <- data[
    data$itag %in% module.genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if(nrow(pattern.sne) == 0) next

  rownames(pattern.sne) <- pattern.sne$itag

  pattern.sne <- pattern.sne[
    ,
    2:ncol(pattern.sne),
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 3. log2(x + 1)
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.sne <- log2(
    as.matrix(pattern.sne) + 1
  )

  pattern.sne[is.infinite(pattern.sne)] <- 0


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 4. Row normalization
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.sne <- data.Normalization(
    pattern.sne,
    type = "n1",
    normalization = "row"
  )

  pattern.sne <- as.matrix(pattern.sne)

  pattern.sne[is.nan(pattern.sne)] <- 0


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 5. Module median / Q1 / Q3
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.summary <- data.frame(

    Stage = colnames(pattern.sne),

    Median = apply(
      pattern.sne,
      2,
      median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Q1 = apply(
      pattern.sne,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Q3 = apply(
      pattern.sne,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  pattern.summary$Stage <- factor(
    pattern.summary$Stage,
    levels = colnames(pattern.sne)
  )


## -------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Interested genes in this module
##    Plot multiple IDs as independent lines
## -------------------------------------------------------

# Reinitialize for each module
interest.long <- NULL

interest.module <- interest.expanded[
  interest.expanded$itag %in% rownames(pattern.sne),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

cat(
  "Module", k,
  ":",
  nrow(interest.module),
  "genes of interest\n"
)


if(nrow(interest.module) > 0){

  ## Process each gene-of-interest entry independently
  interest.list <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(interest.module)),
    function(i){

      gene.id <- interest.module$itag[i]
      gene.name <- interest.module$Name[i]

      expr <- pattern.sne[
        gene.id,
        ,
        drop = TRUE
      ]

      data.frame(
        itag = gene.id,
        Name = gene.name,
        Stage = colnames(pattern.sne),
        Expression = as.numeric(expr),

        Label = paste0(
          gene.name,
          " (",
          gene.id,
          ")"
        ),

        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  interest.long <- do.call(
    rbind,
    interest.list
  )


  ## Preserve tissue/stage order
  interest.long$Stage <- factor(
    interest.long$Stage,
    levels = colnames(pattern.sne)
  )


  ## Preserve legend order from geneid_interest.csv
  interest.long$Label <- factor(
    interest.long$Label,
    levels = unique(
      paste0(
        interest.module$Name,
        " (",
        interest.module$itag,
        ")"
      )
    )
  )
}


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 7. Base plot
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  p <- ggplot(
    pattern.summary,
    aes(
      x = Stage,
      group = 1
    )
  ) +

    # Module Q1-Q3
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = Q1,
        ymax = Q3
      ),
      fill = "grey70",
      alpha = 1
    ) +

    # Module Median
    geom_line(
      aes(y = Median),
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1.5
    )


## -------------------------------------------------------
## 8. Overlay genes of interest
## -------------------------------------------------------

if(nrow(interest.module) > 0){

  p <- p +

    geom_line(
      data = interest.long,
      aes(
        x = Stage,
        y = Expression,
        group = Label,
        colour = Label
      ),
      linewidth = 1
    )
}


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 9. Plot appearance
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  p <- p +

    theme_bw() +

    xlab("Tissue / Stage") +

    ylab("Relative Expression") +

    ggtitle(
      paste0(
        "Module ",
        k,
        " (n = ",
        nrow(pattern.sne),
        ")"
      )
    ) +

    theme(

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 10
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14
      ),

      legend.title = element_blank(),

      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 9
      )
    )


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 10. Display plot
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  print(p)


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 11. Save as EPS
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      "Module_",
      k,
      "_Expression_with_Interest.eps"
    ),
    plot = p,
    device = "eps",
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    units = "in"
  )
}   # End of module loop
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## MODULE TRANSCRIPT PATTERNS
##
## Black line = Module Median
## Grey area  = Module Q1-Q3
##
## All modules except "grey"
## =========================================================


library(ggplot2)


## =========================================================
## 1. MODULE IDs
## =========================================================

# Retrieve module IDs, excluding the unclassified ("grey") group
module.ids <- sort(
  as.numeric(
    setdiff(
      unique(as.character(modules$colors)),
      "grey"
    )
  )
)

# Check dimensions
print(module.ids)
cat("Number of modules:", length(module.ids), "\n")


## =========================================================
## 2. PLOT ALL MODULES
## =========================================================

for (k in module.ids) {

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Processing Module", k, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-1. Genes belonging to module k
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  module.genes <- modules$itag[
    as.character(modules$colors) == as.character(k)
  ]

  # Remove NA and empty gene IDs
  module.genes <- module.genes[
    !is.na(module.genes) &
      module.genes != ""
  ]

  cat(
    "Genes assigned to Module",
    k,
    ":",
    length(module.genes),
    "\n"
  )


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-2. Extract expression data
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.sne <- data[
    data$itag %in% module.genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  cat(
    "Genes found in expression data:",
    nrow(pattern.sne),
    "\n"
  )


  # Skip modules with no matching expression data
  if (nrow(pattern.sne) == 0) {

    cat(
      "No expression data found for Module",
      k,
      "- skipped\n"
    )

    next
  }


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-3. Gene ID → rownames
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  rownames(pattern.sne) <- pattern.sne$itag


  # Remove the gene ID column before numeric transformation
  pattern.sne <- pattern.sne[
    ,
    setdiff(
      colnames(pattern.sne),
      "itag"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-4. Convert to numeric matrix
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.sne <- as.matrix(pattern.sne)

  storage.mode(pattern.sne) <- "numeric"


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-5. log2(x + 1)
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.sne <- log2(
    pattern.sne + 1
  )


  # Replace infinite values with NA
  pattern.sne[
    is.infinite(pattern.sne)
  ] <- NA


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-6. Row normalization
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.sne <- data.Normalization(
    pattern.sne,
    type = "n1",
    normalization = "row"
  )

  pattern.sne <- as.matrix(
    pattern.sne
  )


  # Replace NaN values with 0
  pattern.sne[
    is.nan(pattern.sne)
  ] <- 0


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-7. Module Median / Q1 / Q3
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.summary <- data.frame(

    Stage = colnames(pattern.sne),

    Median = apply(
      pattern.sne,
      2,
      median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Q1 = apply(
      pattern.sne,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Q3 = apply(
      pattern.sne,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-8. Fix tissue / stage order
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  pattern.summary$Stage <- factor(
    pattern.summary$Stage,
    levels = colnames(pattern.sne)
  )


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-9. Plot
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  p <- ggplot(
    pattern.summary,
    aes(
      x = Stage,
      group = 1
    )
  ) +


    ## Q1-Q3
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = Q1,
        ymax = Q3
      ),
      fill = "grey70",
      alpha = 1
    ) +


    ## Module Median
    geom_line(
      aes(
        y = Median
      ),
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1.5
    ) +


    ## -----------------------------------------------------
    ## Labels
    ## -----------------------------------------------------

    xlab(
      "Tissue / Stage"
    ) +

    ylab(
      "Relative Expression"
    ) +

    ggtitle(
      paste0(
        "Module ",
        k,
        " (n = ",
        nrow(pattern.sne),
        ")"
      )
    ) +


    ## -----------------------------------------------------
    ## Theme
    ## -----------------------------------------------------

    theme_bw() +

    theme(

      ## X axis
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 10
      ),

      ## Y axis
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),

      ## Axis titles
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),

      ## Plot title
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      ## No legend
      legend.position = "none"
    )


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-10. Display
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  print(p)


  ## -------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2-11. Save EPS
  ## -------------------------------------------------------

  ggsave(

    filename = paste0(
      "Module_",
      k,
      "_Expression.eps"
    ),

    plot = p,

    device = "eps",

    width = 8,

    height = 6,

    units = "in"
  )


  cat(
    "Saved:",
    paste0(
      "Module_",
      k,
      "_Expression.eps"
    ),
    "\n"
  )

}


## =========================================================
## END
## =========================================================

cat(
  "\nAll module plots completed.\n"
)
```

## COMBINE EXPRESSION VALUES, V6 IDS, COORDINATES, AND MODULES

```{r}
## =========================================================
## FINAL COMBINED TABLE
## =========================================================

# Re-read the original expression matrix so that the exported table retains
# the original tissue/developmental-stage expression values.
expr <- readr::read_csv(
  "physco_mol-plant-data.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Example: Pp1s1_100V6 -> Pp1s1_100V6.1
    itag = paste0(itag, ".1")
  )

# Join expression values to the v6-annotated RSMod module table.
merged <- expr %>%
  dplyr::left_join(modules_v6, by = "itag")

# Retain the columns used for downstream analyses and data sharing.
result <- merged %>%
  dplyr::select(
    itag,
    Gene_ID_v6,
    spores, caulonema, chloronema, gametophore,
    rhizoids, archegonia, S1, S2, S3, SM,
    x, y, z,
    colors
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    V6.1name = Gene_ID_v6,
    module = colors
  )

readr::write_csv(
  result,
  "RSMod_expression_module_table.csv"
)

cat(
  "Saved RSMod_expression_module_table.csv with",
  nrow(result),
  "rows.
"
)
```

## REPRODUCIBILITY NOTES

- `All-Modules-3D-Testing_v6.csv` is generated from `All-Modules-3D-Testing.csv`
  by adding v6 gene IDs from `P.patens_lookup_table_20230906.xlsx`.
- Gene-ID conversion does not alter BH-SNE coordinates or OPTICS module assignments.
- Multiple v1.6-style IDs stored in a single lookup-table cell are separated before mapping.
- Some original gene IDs may not have a corresponding v6 gene ID and therefore remain `NA`.
- For exact reproducibility, retain the input files and package versions used for the analysis.

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```
